description: Produce a comprehensive full-stack audit report as FULLSTACK_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md at the repo root. The report covers: 1) Build Quality (can it compile/build?), 2) Test Coverage (which tests pass/fail?), 3) Architecture Audit (9-pillar verification, service connectivity, dead code, unused deps), 4) Functionality Audit (missing implementations, broken pipelines, placeholder code), 5) Security Audit (secrets handling, CORS, rate limiting, input validation), 6) Performance Audit (circuit breakers, caching, streaming), 7) CI/CD Audit (workflow correctness, coverage). Use findings from FEAT-001 test runs plus deep code analysis.
steps: Read FEAT-001 findings for build/test results
Analyze architecture: verify all 9 pillars are implemented (Cloudflare edge, Azure backend, Azure Search, MongoDB, Upstash Redis, Cloudflare Workers AI/Vertex AI, Sarvam AI, Razorpay, Resend)
Check for dead code: vertex_client.py is imported but router.py routes English to Cloudflare, not Vertex. Identify all such inconsistencies.
Check for missing implementations: scan for TODO, FIXME, NotImplementedError, pass-only functions
Analyze security: JWT handling, password validation, CORS config, rate limiting double-layer (edge+backend), CSRF, CSP headers
Analyze build quality: Docker multi-stage build, dependency pinning, TypeScript strict mode, Python type hints
Analyze CI/CD: 24 workflows correctness, coverage thresholds, deployment pipeline
Analyze performance: circuit breakers, Redis caching, search warm-up, streaming SSE, connection pooling
Write comprehensive report to /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya/FULLSTACK_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md with all sections, findings, severity ratings, and recommendations
acceptance_criteria: Report contains sections: Executive Summary, Build Quality, Test Results, Architecture Audit (9 Pillars), Functionality Audit, Security Audit, Performance Audit, CI/CD Audit, Recommendations
Each finding has a severity rating (Critical/High/Medium/Low/Info)
Report is based on actual code analysis, not generic advice
findings: Audit report written at FULLSTACK_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md (17469 chars, 338 lines). 1 Critical finding (AI model routing inconsistency between ChatService.resolve_language_and_model and router.py), 3 High, 5 Medium, 4 Low, 3 Info findings. All 9 pillars verified as implemented. Zero TODO/FIXME/NotImplementedError in codebase. Vertex AI is NOT dead code - it is used by seo_generator.py and content_generation.py for offline content generation, but the routing inconsistency in ChatService is real.
